title: GitHub - CCA Automations are delayed when starting an Automation
text:
Service: GitHub
Incident: CCA Automations are delayed when starting an Automation
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-15T18:31:49.832Z
Resolved: 2026-10-15T18:56:04.250Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-15T18:56:04.250Z: resolved - We suspected that CCA Automations were experiencing delays when users start an Automation, but further investigation found that there was no delay or impact to CCA Automations. 
- 2026-10-15T18:53:04.477Z: monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
- 2026-10-15T18:34:34.711Z: investigating - CCA Automations are experiencing delays when users start an Automation
- 2026-10-15T18:31:49.894Z: investigating - We are investigating reports of impacted performance for some GitHub services.
